state:
Goal `core-uuid` is reached. All seven `Core\Uuid` members have every feature proof, and
`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Uuid'` reports nothing owed and 0 failed. Their cards in
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs` are in the plain voice. `bun nv verify --doc`,
`bun nv owners --closes core-uuid` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-uuid` are green.

The `tryParse` attack no longer carries a gap marker: the release `nvs` runs it in about 0.3 s.
Gap `nvs-runtime/a-core-call-with-a-large-string-costs-time-per-byte` now records that the per-byte
cost is in the debug build only. It is owned by M12. Until it is fixed, the sweep's recording run on
the debug binary never finishes that attack, so it prints `diverged` and runs on every sweep. That is
not a failure.
